mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals deteriorating consumer demand, prompting central bank stimulus that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.0%, it signals recessionary conditions that trigger central bank easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) signals deepening economic contraction, triggering central bank intervention that produces positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95 and PAYEMS < 136500.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS ≤ 1.0%), further economic deterioration (e.g., INDPRO decline) triggers quantitative easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS ≤ 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply-side contraction, prompting central bank stimulus that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 1.0%, it indicates aggressive monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals severe demand contraction, triggering central bank stimulus that produces positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 850 and UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle recession regimes (UNRATE > 6.0% and HOUST < 850), weak consumer demand (HOUST) and high unemployment (UNRATE) prompt central bank intervention, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0% and HOUST < 850.
